title: Crew themes, flair and early access
detail: PHASE 4 of the five-tier ladder (ADR-1709), the later row. Crew perks beyond hosting: profile themes, flair, early access to new features. Shipped: lib/crew/perks.ts, the one registry for themes, flair and early_access with a live flag, wired into the profile theme writer (a Crew theme is refused to a non-Crew member on the real effective tier), the appearance rail (crewPerks hides Crew themes), and /upgrade (lists only live perks). Nothing is live yet: no Crew theme is authored (Midnight stays owner-held), and Crew flair and early access need a render value and a feature first, so no member-facing copy changed.

verify.cmd: node -e 'const fs=require("fs");const r=(f)=>fs.existsSync(f)?fs.readFileSync(f,"utf8"):"";const fail=(m)=>{console.error(m);process.exit(1)};const s=r("lib/crew/perks.ts");if(!/early_access/.test(s)||!/theme/.test(s))fail("no Crew perks module with themes and early access");console.log("ok: Crew perks exist")'
